description: Retrieval test set: for each question, the text that the correct chunk must contain (analyst-written).

items.question: Is the company involved in litigation, lawsuits or court cases?
Is anyone suing the company over its technology?
Is there any sanctions, ownership or compliance risk?
Has the company gone through restructuring, losses or insolvency, and is it resolved?
Does the company depend on one large customer?
How long does the contract with the biggest client run?
When did the company become profitable?
